description: Figure 5 represents an error analysis comparison between the Vanilla model and the HCL model, with two pie charts shown side by side. There are four slices in each chart. In the left chart, the slices are labeled "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark gray, approximately 68%), "Correct" (light gray, approximately 12%), "Reason Error" (gray, approximately 12%), and "Question Misunderstood" (white, approximately 8%). In the right chart, the slices are labeled "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark gray, approximately 55%), "Correct" (light gray, approximately 21%), "Reason Error" (gray, approximately 14%), and "Question Misunderstood" (white, approximately 10%). Both charts include percentage labels inside the slices, and the labels are also associated with distinct colors, although a legend is not provided. The slices in both charts are ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
